$comment: Source of truth for Miau design-system primitives. Hand-maintained; keep tokens.css in sync. Colors are sRGB hex. Apps ride on libadwaita semantic colors (see 'semantic') and add their own 'accent' set.

semantic.$comment: NOT defined by us — these are libadwaita named colors we build on. Listed here so apps know the vocabulary to use instead of hardcoding greys. They follow the user's light/dark theme automatically.

accent.$comment: The only colors we define ourselves. One accent hue + a gold used for favourites. Each has a *_light variant tuned for dark backgrounds.
accent.$note_favourite: Product uses gold for the favourited heart via easel_gold; the Figma mockup used red #ff5d6c. Pick one per app; documented as a known divergence.

overlay.$comment: Alpha-on-black / alpha-on-white overlays for badges and scrims that must read on top of arbitrary photos.

space.$comment: 4px- based spacing scale. Names map to the app's SPACE_* usage.

radius.$comment: Corner radii by role, taken from Easel's style.css.

type.$comment: Chrome is monospace; body/headings can use the UI font. Sizes in px.

elevation.$comment: Shadows. 'paper' lifts the content surface; 'raised' is for the selected/hover state if used.
